Built on trust

Quality you can trace, from field to store.

Golden Grain Market connects buyers with carefully selected farmers across Kurdistan and Northern Iraq. We combine modern grading, protected storage and disciplined logistics to deliver agricultural products that perform consistently.

✓

Measured quality standards

Moisture, purity, protein and visual grade checks for each incoming batch.
